thread:
Mateo: Heads up — quick pulse: are we green on egress probes for ACME private rollout? Cutover Friday. Need network owners + CR approval. TL;DR: probe fails from staging.
OpsBot: PROBE ALERT: egress-prober-staging -> 10.2.0.0/16 failed (tcp 443). Run /prober status.
Lina: @Mateo I saw fail history. Firewall team changed egress ACLs yesterday. I can whitelist the probe IPs but need CR id and justification.
Mateo: CR is CR-3921. Justification: cutover test. Can we fast-track? :eyes:
Lina: ACK. I'll open a scoped exception ticket and ping infra lead @Alex.
Alex: Looping in security — what exactly is being allowed? We need KMS/AWS-GW details. Also, can the prober use the VPC NAT instead of new outbound rules?
Priya: @Lina @Alex quick note: the probe app is in staging cluster staging-2 and uses 203.0.113.45 as source. It's running the curl-check job. PR is https://github.com/redwood/prober/pull/76 (needs code owner review from eng-infra).
Casey: I can run curl from staging node to test. Mateo, can you paste exact curl command the prober uses?
Mateo: Sure — command:
```curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://acme.health/status -H 'X-Probe: egress'```
Casey: Ran it from staging-2 node via bastion, got 403. tcpdump shows RST from 10.0.4.1. Suggest we add NAT route to 203.0.113.0/24.
Lina: 10.0.4.1 is egress firewall. I'll request firewall rule change to allow 203.0.113.45 -> acme-health on 443. Ticket: FW-1289. ETA 4 hours if approved.
Jordan: Customer planning cutover 2pm PT. If this slips we need rollback window. Please flag if not green by 11am.
Priya: Also PR #76 still needs review from @eng-infra. @Casey can you do a quick CR for the retry backoff?
Casey: On it, will review in 15-30m.
Alex: Security ok with scoped exception if we log and revoke post-cutover. Please add SCC rule and TTL 24h.
Lina: :thumbsup: opening emergency CR now. Adding SCC logs. Will ping when FR changes merged.
OpsBot: PROBE OK: egress-prober-staging -> acme.health (https) succeeded (200) — last checked 1912350000
Mateo: Awesome. @Jordan we can proceed as long as CR closes after cutover. Thanks everyone.
Jordan: :party: booked 2pm PT slot. Will watch.
